newsitem.title: USA: Dow industrials languish, hampered by bond market.
newsitem.headline: Dow industrials languish, hampered by bond market.

text.p: The Dow industrials drifted at negative levels on Tuesday, unable to shake continued declines in the bond market, while technology stocks remained strong.

The Dow Jones Industrial average was off 28 points at 8171, while the long bond lost 7/32 to yield 6.50 percent. Bonds, whose yields have recently climbed again amid renewed inflation fears, focused on an upcoming Treasury auction.
"The stock market is still waiting for the bond market to find its footing," Jim Benning, a BT Brokerage trader said.
But Nasdaq and the technology stocks it features were buoyant, with the index up nine points at 1615.
